scope.rule: Select every direct ThML.body div1 carrier in source order. This is a complete technical envelope only; it does not decide the work, part, edition, or witness boundary.

scripCom.tei_semantics: Represent the empty source marker as an empty TEI milestone at the same block-flow position; map the passage to n and OSIS reference to corresp.
scripCom.other_source_attributes: Retain exact name and value in source-accountability.features; parsed is not promoted as independent authority.

ol.children: Preserve the exact source child sequence; li maps to item.

feature_policy.element_ids: Assign deterministic TEI xml:id values src-1 through src-N in selected source preorder and record a one-to-one source path, native id, source tag, and full source attribute map for every selected element.
feature_policy.text_and_order: Preserve source element text, tail, child order, nested source elements, and source comments within selected carriers.
feature_policy.navigation: Keep source ids, titles, prev, next, and progress exact in the feature ledger; do not reinterpret navigation attributes as body prose.
feature_policy.unselected_body_wrapper_comments: Account in document_shell and body_node_sequence; do not silently discard.

identity_boundary: The work id and exact title are route bindings supported by this issue and the retained DC.Title; the title-page/header envelope is not a settled work boundary.
Form and edition identifiers are operational route labels only. The textual form, translation status, print lineage, exact edition, constituent parts, and witness scope remain unresolved.
The source DC.Language value is an electronic-source observation; no original-language claim is added.
Provider dates and rights statements are not promoted to adopted edition dates, project rights clearance, acceptance, release, or publication.

candidate_questions.question: Which title-page, reader matter, numbered sections, appendix, and index carriers belong to the cataloged work or to distinct supporting works?
candidate_questions.evidence_boundary: The retained member contains 25 ordered div1 carriers; complete-envelope selection is not a semantic work decision.
candidate_questions.technical_disposition: Retain all carrier evidence in this route slice and defer semantic partitioning.

candidate_questions.question: What textual form or translation status does this retained English ThML witness represent?
candidate_questions.evidence_boundary: The retained DC.Language is an electronic-source statement and does not settle original language or translation history.
candidate_questions.technical_disposition: Use only route-local language and form labels; leave textual-form identity unresolved.

candidate_questions.question: Which print exemplar, if any, underlies this electronic CCEL witness?
candidate_questions.evidence_boundary: The retained 1660 source statement does not identify an exact print exemplar or establish transcription lineage.
candidate_questions.technical_disposition: Assert no print date, edition identity, or witness lineage.

candidate_questions.question: Are the reader matter, appendix, and indexes parts of one work or separate works and paratext?
candidate_questions.evidence_boundary: Their source order and carrier boundaries are observable; their catalog relationships are not decided by this route slice.
candidate_questions.technical_disposition: Preserve the complete carrier envelope and defer part relationships.

candidate_questions.question: What independent rights evidence governs later acceptance or publication?
candidate_questions.evidence_boundary: The retained DC.Rights value is a source statement, not project rights clearance.
candidate_questions.technical_disposition: No rights, release, or publication state is changed by this route slice.
